summary: Neurogene Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an underwritten public offering of 3,500,000 common shares at $30.00/share and 666,666 pre-funded warrants at $29.999999/warrant, with the underwriters' option exercised in full for 624,999 additional shares. Net proceeds are ~$134.8M, with a closing date of July 2, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown under a previously effective registration statement (333-286057), not a special situation. The filing lacks any strategic event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring; it is ordinary equity financing. Watch for typical market absorption post-offering; no arbitrage angle exists.
